title: Model Context Protocol
content: MCP allows AI models to interact with external tools and access local data safely.

title: Process Scheduling
content: The operating system decides which process runs at a given time using scheduling algorithms such as round robin or priority scheduling.

title: React Component State
content: State in React stores data that can change over time and causes the component to re-render when updated.

title: Git Basics
content: Git tracks changes in files and allows branching, committing, and merging to manage software versions.

title: SQL Joins
content: Joins in SQL combine rows from two or more tables based on related columns, enabling more complex queries.

title: Binary Search
content: Binary search finds an element in a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

title: TCP vs UDP
content: TCP is connection-oriented and reliable, while UDP is connectionless and often used for latency-sensitive traffic.

title: Password Hashing
content: Secure systems store password hashes rather than plaintext passwords to reduce the impact of data breaches.

title: REST APIs
content: REST APIs expose resources over HTTP and use standard methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.

title: Deadlocks
content: A deadlock occurs when processes wait on each other indefinitely because each holds resources needed by another.

title: Normalization
content: Database normalization reduces redundancy and improves data integrity by organizing tables efficiently.

title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
content: Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest path from a source node to all other nodes in a weighted graph.

title: HTTP Status Codes
content: Common HTTP status codes include 200 OK, 404 Not Found, and 500 Internal Server Error.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Two-factor authentication adds an extra verification step to make account access more secure.

title: React Hooks
content: Hooks let functional components use state and lifecycle features without writing class components.

title: What is an operating system?
content: An operating system manages hardware resources and provides services for applications.

title: What is a database index?
content: A database index improves query performance by allowing faster lookup of rows.

title: What is HTTPS?
content: HTTPS is the secure version of HTTP that encrypts data exchanged between a client and a server.
